Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT 3.3; UAT TC-17 ER; TFA-92595 AC 8 · “Unless a case says Hospital-only or Nursing-Home-only, it is run in both and must pass in both”.

Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S09 Nursing Home Post-Round: the same structure as Hospital, and each pending-task choice on two residents, with a Hospital patient under the same physician left untouched

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Both modes (ground rule 3.3): TC-17 does not say Hospital-only, so every outcome above must hold in Hospital and in Nursing Home. The ticket has no Hospital/Nursing Home AC (Q3). (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-17) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U1 The Note / Tasks / Meds toggle shows only one section at a time, and each section shows its own correct content (the three views hold correct, independent data). (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 2; TFA-92595 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U4 With pending tasks, 'Mark Encounter Complete' opens the Pending Tasks prompt with three choices, and each works: Delete & complete deletes the pending tasks and completes; … (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 8; TFA-92595 How it works 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U7 The Meds toggle shows the same Medication Tracker (same data) as the Encounter tab. (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 5; TFA-92595 How it works 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U8 With pending tasks on two patients, 'Delete & complete' on one removes only that patient's pending tasks. (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T4 'Mark Encounter Complete' is present and functional from all three toggles (Note, Tasks, Meds), not just Note. (TFA-92595 AC 7; TFA-92595 How it works 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T5 The Pending Tasks prompt appears exactly when tasks remain: never with 0 open tasks, always with ≥1, listing the open tasks; never before the encounter's derived tasks are in. (TFA-92595 AC 8; TFA-92595 How it works 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T7 The Note tab shows tomorrow's Pre-Round summary underneath the note. (TFA-92595 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given One physician: Nursing Home resident R1 with note N-N, two open and one done task and three tracker rows (one held); resident R2 with one open task; Hospital patient H in note-ready with an open task whose text is the same as one of R1's

When R1: Post-Round note view (cp1); meds toggle, or tasks if there is none (cp2); tap the complete button: prompt (cp3) → Cancel (cp4) → tap it again → Delete Pending Tasks & Complete, tasks toggle (cp5). R2: Post-Round tasks toggle (cp6) → complete button → Keep Tasks & Mark Complete → reload, tasks toggle (cp7). …

Then Same structure as Hospital (Ask button, note / tasks / meds toggles, Copy to EMR, Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary, 'Mark Encounter Complete'), with the note view showing only the note; the prompt lists R1's two open tasks with the three choices; Cancel completes nothing; after Delete only QA-N3 is left and R1 is complete; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint. Table: (R1, Cancel) → nothing; (R1, Delete) → only R1's open tasks gone, its done task kept; (R2, untouched) → open, complete button present; (R2, Keep) → complete, open after a reload; (H, other context, same task text) → untouched. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
